name: Body as topology
description: Bodies, limbs, hands, posture and multiplicity can act as geometry, rhythm, obstruction, tension or mass rather than neutral casting.

name: Threshold / occlusion / containment
description: Crop, obstacle, aperture, arch, circle and frame-within-frame can delay recognition and make incomplete visibility active.

name: Material interference / agency
description: Matter changes motion, visibility, scale or pressure and is treated as behavior rather than decorative texture.

name: Representational-state collision
description: Photographic, drawn, flat, monochrome, degraded and CG states can collide or transform inside one visual system.

name: Spatial withholding / ordinary reality
description: Distance, negative space and materially ordinary environments can carry dramatic pressure; a precise rupture is stronger when the whole frame is not competing to look extraordinary.

name: Continuity before generation
description: Separate locked invariants from allowed variables before multiplying shots; judge candidates against approved source authority rather than vague similarity.

name: Product fidelity as acceptance system
description: Convert product truth into explicit acceptance fields and reject visually strong candidates that change product facts.

Do not infer futuristic offices, holographic command centres, neon/chrome cyberpunk, desert monumentalism, a Dune-like world or one universal glossy CGI finish from the category label AI production studio.
